notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: name, county and coordinates match the Association county list, and status Gone is right. No source read gives a build year, staffing, fires, access or the site today, so none is stated and access is not set. The Facebook post is only a short cached snippet (about 180 characters, cut off mid-sentence after 'a mile or so on the No'). Evidence [2] quotes its sentence about the former tower, and the story paraphrases that sentence. An earlier note mentioned body text about a 100 ft International Stacey tower built in 1933; the cache checked on 2026-10-21 does not contain it, so nothing from it is used. Check the post in a browser before adding any date. The Association Virginia list gives no registry number for this site. Confidence low.
